2 use something and return it = ................................. it

exercises.instruction: Find pairs of objects from the box which have a logical connection, and write down what th[e] [?] connection is. Look at the example first.
items: Example: You put a cassette in a tape recorder.
1 I'd like all of you to write this word .................... in your books.
2 Maria, could you ........................ in the tape recorder and turn it on?
3 Will you .................... my English if I make any mistakes?
4 I've written the wrong word in my book. Could I use your ..................... ?
